messages:
Priya S.: Quick sync — I pushed the PRD draft + an acceptance matrix to the doc. Need cross-team pairing to map customer asks -> acceptance criteria and final sign-offs this week. Who can review?

Maya G.: I can start. I'll pair with an engineer for edge cases.

Tom R.: Ops: we need clarified SLOs and rollback plan before sign-off. Can you add perf thresholds to the matrix?

Priya S.: Yes — that's on my list. Proposed SLOs: p95 latency < 350ms for standard route, error rate < 0.5%. Adding rollback trigger: sustained error rate > 1% for 5m. Thoughts?

Jess L.: latency target seems okay but we should call out cold-starts. Suggest: exclude first-token latency for warmed/pooled instances or document fallback behavior. Also we need an edge-case: very long inputs (>12k tokens) should return 413 + guidance, not hang.

Ali Khan: Customer ask from BetaCorp: they want guaranteed region affinity (EU only) and a way to pin to quantized model variant. This matters for acceptance. Can we map that to acceptance tests?

Maya G.: I'll add a row to the matrix: "region affinity" => test: requests from EU test client routed to EU in 3/3 attempts; owner: eng-runtime; acceptance: no cross-region egress.

Product Bot: Checklist added to PRD: [x] acceptance matrix, [ ] perf SLOs, [ ] rollback plan, [ ] stakeholder sign-off, [ ] communication plan.

Tom R.: For pin-to-quantized-model: we need a compatibility test matrix (model variant + tokenization + behavior diff <= 2% on sampled prompts). Ops also needs cost delta baseline.

Priya S.: Good point. I'll add that as acceptance criterion: "behavior delta <= 2% on eval set OR documented known regressions with mitigation plan." Who will own the eval?

Jess L.: Eng-ML can run the eval. @Maya G. can you own the test harness?

Maya G.: Yep, I'll own harness and test definitions. ETA: EOD Thu for first pass.

Ali Khan: Also need a customer communication template for BetaCorp if we plan any feature gating. I'll draft and share with marketing.

Priya S.: Action items so far:
- Maya: harness + matrix rows (region affinity, quantized pin) — EOD Thu
- Eng-ML: behavior eval for quantized variant — Fri noon
- Tom: finalize rollback thresholds + cost baseline — Thu EOD
- Priya: update PRD with SLOs & add canary rollout plan + decision log entry — Thu morning
- Ali: customer comms draft — Thu afternoon

Jess L.: One more edge case: upstream tokenization mismatch -> truncated outputs. Add acceptance test for tokenization roundtrip on 5 representative languages.

Product Bot: New decision log entry created: "Pinning to quantized model allowed only if behavior delta <= 2% OR signed mitigation approved" by Priya S.

Priya S.: For stakeholder sign-off, propose this flow:
1) Engineering checklist pass (tests + perf)
2) Product sign-off (me)
3) Sales/customer success acknowledgment (Ali)
4) Legal/security if any PII/data residency dependencies

Tom R.: Approve workflow, add timebox for sign-off (48h) to avoid blocking.

Maya G.: Will put test ownership rows in the doc with owners + Slack handles.

Ali Khan: I'll coordinate BetaCorp timing once we have canary windows. Please ping me when rollout plan has dates.

Priya S.: Decision for this thread: proceed with canary rollout gated by the eval and perf SLOs. If either fails, rollback. I'll add final acceptance matrix row and request formal approvals by Friday COB.

ReleaseBot: Reminder: if canary approved, create release ticket with tag `canary/region-eu` and include runbook link.

Jess L.: +1 to the plan.

Tom R.: +1 (pending cost baseline).

Ali Khan: +1 from Customer Success side, will hold customer comms until canary date confirmed. :thumbsup:

Priya S.: Thanks all. I'll post updated PRD link in this thread when done.

Product Bot: PRD updated: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/1795001234 — reviewers notified: @MayaG @TomR @AliK @JessL

Priya S.: (posted updated matrix) — requesting final sign-offs by Friday 18:00 PT.

Maya G.: Noted. Will review test harness results when available.

Tom R.: Will share cost numbers by Thu EOD.

Ali Khan: Will coordinate customer-facing message after you confirm dates.

Jess L.: Leaving detailed comments in the doc.

Priya S.: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any blockers come up before sign-off.
